## Adult Cave Dragon (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
 NE Large dragon (earth)  
 **Init** -1; **Senses** blindsense 180 ft.; Perception +18  

**Defense**

 **AC** 30, touch 9, flat-footed 30 (+21 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 280 (14d12+112)  
 **Fort** +17, **Ref** +9, **Will** +13  
 **Defensive Abilities** darkness aura; **DR** 5/good;  
 **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep, sonic; **SR** 18  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., burrow 20 ft.; earth glide  
 **Melee** bite +24 (2d8+10), 2 claws +21 (1d8+5), 2 wings +21 (1d6+5), and 1 tail slap +21 (1d8+5)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (40 ft. cone, poison DC 25, 1d6+6 Strength damage; sonic 12d6 sonic), ruff spikes  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 14th)  

  3/day—darkness, deeper darkness  

 **Spells Prepared** (CL 7th, +11 concentration)  

  4th—cure critical wounds, death ward, divination  
 3rd—cure serious wounds, dispel magic, invisibility purge, speak with dead  
 2nd—cure moderate wounds, deathwatch, detect thoughts (DC 16), hold person (DC 16), silence  
 1st—comprehend languages, cure light wounds, deathwatch, doom (DC 15), entropic shield, protection from good  
 0th—bleed (DC 14), detect magic, mending, read magic  

 **Domains** Evil, Knowledge  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 30 **Dex** 8 **Con** 26 **Int** 16 **Wis** 18 **Cha** 19  
 **Base Atk** +14; **CMB** +24 (+26 for Bull Rush); **CMD** 33 (37 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Awesome Blow, Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Bluff +18, Climb +18, Diplomacy +18, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +19, Knowledge (local) +18, Linguistics +15, Perception +18, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +20, Survival +17; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Climb, +4 Stealth  
 **Languages** Draconic, Undercommon  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground  
 **Organization** solitary or pair  
 **Treasure** double
